1: // Minimal side‑scroll runner with simple graphics improvements
2: (() => {
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   if (!canvas) return;
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   const width = canvas.width;
7:   const height = canvas.height;
8:   const groundHeight = 20; // height of ground platform
9:   // simple audio setup using Web Audio API
10:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
11:   function playSound(freq, duration = 0.1) {
12:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
13:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
14:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
15:     osc.type = 'sine';
16:     osc.connect(gain);
17:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
18:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
19:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
20:     osc.start();
21:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
22:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
23:   }
24:   function playJumpSound() { playSound(440, 0.08); }
25:   function playGameOverSound() { playSound(150, 0.5); }
26: 
27: 
28:   // player is a simple triangle character
29:   const player = {
30:     x: 50,
31:     // start on ground platform
32:     y: height - groundHeight - 30,
33:     w: 20,
34:     h: 30,
35:     vy: 0,
36:     gravity: 0.6,
37:     jumpStrength: -12,
38:     onGround: true,
39:     draw() {
40:       // draw triangle pointing right
41:       ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
42:       ctx.beginPath();
43:       ctx.moveTo(this.x, this.y + this.h / 2);
44:       ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.w, this.y);
45:       ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.w, this.y + this.h);
46:       ctx.closePath();
47:       ctx.fill();
48:     },
49:     update() {
50:       this.vy += this.gravity;
51:       this.y += this.vy;
52:       if (this.y + this.h >= height - groundHeight) {
53:         this.y = height - groundHeight - this.h;
54:         this.vy = 0;
55:         this.onGround = true;
56:       } else {
57:         this.onGround = false;
58:       }
59:     },
60:     jump() {
61:       if (this.onGround) this.vy = this.jumpStrength;
62:     }
63:   };
64: 
65:   const obstacles = [];
66:   let obstacleTimer = 0;
67:   const obstacleInterval = 90; // frames between obstacles
68:   const speed = 4;
69:   // cloud handling
70:   const clouds = [];
71:   let cloudTimer = 0;
72:   const cloudInterval = 150; // frames between clouds
73:   const cloudSpeed = 1;
74: 
75:   function spawnCloud() {
76:     const radius = 20 + Math.random() * 30;
77:     const y = 20 + Math.random() * (height / 3);
78:     clouds.push({ x: width, y, r: radius });
79:   }
80: 
81:   function updateClouds() {
82:     for (let i = clouds.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
83:       const c = clouds[i];
84:       c.x -= cloudSpeed;
85:       if (c.x + c.r < 0) clouds.splice(i, 1);
86:     }
87:   }
88: 
89:   function drawClouds() {
90:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)';
91:     clouds.forEach(c => {
92:       ctx.beginPath();
93:       ctx.arc(c.x, c.y, c.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
94:       ctx.fill();
95:     });
96:   }
97: 
98:   function spawnObstacle() {
99:     const size = 20 + Math.random() * 30; // height 20‑50
100:     obstacles.push({ x: width, y: height - groundHeight - size, w: 20, h: size });
101:   }
102: 
103:   function updateObstacles() {
104:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
105:       const o = obstacles[i];
106:       o.x -= speed;
107:       if (o.x + o.w < 0) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
108:     }
109:   }
110: 
111:   function drawObstacles() {
112:     // draw obstacles as brown blocks with a slight gradient
113:     obstacles.forEach(o => {
114:       const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(o.x, o.y, o.x, o.y + o.h);
115:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#8B4513'); // saddle brown top
116:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#A0522D'); // sienna bottom
117:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
118:       ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h);
119:     });
120:   }
121: 
122:   function checkCollision() {
123:     const p = player;
124:     for (const o of obstacles) {
125:       if (
126:         p.x < o.x + o.w &&
127:         p.x + p.w > o.x &&
128:         p.y < o.y + o.h &&
129:         p.y + p.h > o.y
130:       ) {
131:         return true;
132:       }
133:     }
134:     return false;
135:   }
136: 
137:   let gameOver = false;
138:   function loop() {
139:     if (gameOver) {
140:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
141:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
142:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
143:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
144:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
145:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
146:       return;
147:     }
148:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
149:     // draw sky gradient background
150:     const skyGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, height);
151:     skyGrad.addColorStop(0, '#87CEEB'); // light blue top
152:     skyGrad.addColorStop(1, '#B0E0E6'); // pale blue bottom
153:     ctx.fillStyle = skyGrad;
154:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
155:     // draw simple clouds
156:     drawClouds();
157:     // ground platform
158:     ctx.fillStyle = '#654321';
159:     ctx.fillRect(0, height - groundHeight, width, groundHeight);
160: 
161:     // update clouds
162:     if (cloudTimer <= 0) {
163:       spawnCloud();
164:       cloudTimer = cloudInterval;
165:     } else {
166:       cloudTimer--;
167:     }
168:     updateClouds();
169: 
170:     // update & draw player
171:     player.update();
172:     player.draw();
173: 
174:     // obstacles
175:     if (obstacleTimer <= 0) {
176:       spawnObstacle();
177:       obstacleTimer = obstacleInterval;
178:     } else {
179:       obstacleTimer--;
180:     }
181:     updateObstacles();
182:     drawObstacles();
183: 
184:     if (checkCollision()) {
185:       playGameOverSound();
186:       gameOver = true;
187:     }
188:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
189:   }
190:     
191:   }
192: 
193:   // start on user interaction (required by some browsers)
194:   const start = () => {
195:     // unlock audio on first interaction
196:     audioCtx.resume();
197:     canvas.removeEventListener('click', start);
198:     canvas.addEventListener('click', () => { playJumpSound(); player.jump(); });
199:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
200:   };
201:   canvas.addEventListener('click', start);
202: })();

(End of file - total 202 lines)
</content>
